interface.name: touchbar_manager_v1

description.summary: assigns a managed role to Touch Bar plugin surfaces

interface.description: The manager gives plugin surfaces compositor-controlled geometry. A wl_surface may receive this role only once.

request.name: get_item_surface

description.summary: assign a role with stable item and sizing metadata

request.description: Zero expanded widths declare that this item cannot begin a presentation. Otherwise both compact and expanded widths must be ordered minimum, preferred, maximum with no zero compact values. Anchored, in-place, and slot policies resolve the expanded constraints; named-region and full-bar policies use their exact daemon-owned width. Widths are constraints; the compositor owns final geometry.

request.name: get_backdrop_surface

description.summary: assign a non-interactive full-canvas backdrop role

request.description: The compositor configures this surface to the complete logical canvas and places it below item and overlay surfaces. At most one backdrop is active. Its alpha is composed over the compositor fallback color.

description.summary: subscribe to atomic semantic appearance snapshots

interface.name: touchbar_appearance_v1
interface.description: A snapshot starts with begin, contains exactly one value for each core color role, and becomes active only on done. Colors use unpremultiplied 0xRRGGBBAA encoding; renderers must premultiply at rasterization time.

interface.name: touchbar_surface_v1
interface.description: A role for one plugin surface. The compositor chooses its dimensions and placement; attached buffers must match the most recently acknowledged configure event.

entry.name: duplicate_acquire_fence
entry.summary: more than one acquire fence was supplied for one commit

entry.name: acquire_fence_without_buffer
entry.summary: an acquire fence was committed without a buffer

entry.name: acquire_fence_unsupported_buffer
entry.summary: an acquire fence was supplied for a non-DMA-BUF buffer

entry.name: invalid_acquire_fence
entry.summary: the supplied fd is not a valid Linux sync_file

request.name: set_acquire_fence

description.summary: set a GPU acquire fence for the next surface commit

request.description:
The fd must refer to a Linux sync_file produced after rendering the buffer attached by the next wl_surface.commit. The compositor imports it and queues a GPU-side wait before sampling that DMA-BUF; it never blocks its event thread. The fence is single-use double-buffered state. Supplying more than one fence before a commit, committing without a buffer, or attaching a non-DMA-BUF buffer is a protocol error.
A client may omit this request when its graphics stack provides only implicit DMA-BUF synchronization. The TouchBar Rust GLES runtime sends it whenever EGL_ANDROID_native_fence_sync is available.

entry.name: anchored
entry.summary: bounded overlay anchored to its compact item

entry.name: slot
entry.summary: overlay assigned to a named user slot

entry.name: region
entry.summary: overlay assigned to a named user region

entry.name: transient
entry.summary: bound to the supplied captured contact

entry.name: physical
entry.summary: contact from the physical Touch Bar

entry.name: synthetic
entry.summary: developer preview or test input without user-activation authority

request.name: begin_presentation
request.description: session_id must be nonzero and monotonically unique within the surface. A transient lifecycle requires a nonzero captured contact. Persistent lifecycle requires contact_id zero. target is empty for anchored, in-place, and full-bar policies and names daemon-owned slots or regions.

request.name: end_presentation

description.summary: end only the matching active session

request.description: A stale session ID is ignored and cannot dismiss a newer presentation.

event.name: touch_down

description.summary: touch down with a compositor-issued gesture sequence

event.description: sequence_hi and sequence_lo form one nonzero 64-bit sequence that is stable for the complete captured contact and unique for the compositor process lifetime.
